result.topic_en: The page derives the solution of a heat-conduction problem with a radiation boundary condition $\partial u/\partial x - vu + a = 0$ at $x=0$, building $u$ by Duhamel superposition of error-function integrals and finding $\varphi$ as a power series in $t^{1/2}$ using Gauss's $\Pi$ function; two lines of Kurrent prose are written upside down across the middle.
result.transcription:
$u = \int_0^t u_\tau \varphi'\tau\, \partial\tau = \int_0^t \partial\tau \int_{\frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{t-\tau}}}^{\infty} \varphi'\tau\, e^{-yy}\, \partial y =$ [-$\varphi t$-]
[-$t-\tau > \frac{4\alpha\alpha}{xx\,yy}$-]
$y > \frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{t-\tau}}$ \quad $= \int_{\frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{t}}}^{\infty} e^{-yy}\partial y \int_0^{t-\frac{xx}{4yy\alpha\alpha}} \varphi'\tau\, \partial\tau$
$\frac{4\alpha\alpha}{xx}(t-\tau) > \frac{1}{yy} > 0$
$t - \frac{xx}{4yy\alpha\alpha} > \tau > 0$ \quad $u = \int_{\frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{t}}}^{\infty} e^{-yy}\, \varphi\left(t - \frac{xx}{4yy\alpha\alpha}\right) \partial y$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \int_{\frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{t}}}^{\infty} e^{-yy}\, \varphi'\left(t-\frac{xx}{4yy\alpha\alpha}\right) \cdot -\frac{2x}{4yy\alpha\alpha}\,\partial y$
$= \int_{\frac{1}{2\alpha\sqrt{t}}}^{\infty} e^{-xxzz}\, \varphi'\left(t-\frac{1}{4zz\alpha\alpha}\right) \cdot -\frac{2\,\partial z}{4zz\alpha\alpha}$ \quad $2z\alpha = \sqrt{t}$[?]
$= \int_t^0 e^{-\frac{xx}{4\alpha\alpha s}}\, \varphi'(t-s) \cdot -s^{\frac12}\, \partial s^{-\frac12}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = -\frac{1}{2\alpha}\int_0^t e^{-\frac{xx}{4\alpha\alpha s}}\, \varphi'(t-s)\, \frac{\partial s}{s^{\frac12}}$
$\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} - vu + a = 0\right)$ \quad $x = 0$
$-\frac{1}{2\alpha}\int_0^t \varphi'(t-s)\frac{\partial s}{s^{\frac12}} - v\,\Pi\tfrac12\, \varphi t + a = 0$ \quad $\varphi t = \sum a_m t^m$ \quad $\alpha v = \beta$
$-\frac{1}{2\alpha}\int_0^1 \varphi' t(1-y)\, t\frac{\partial y}{\sqrt{ty}}$ [-$\sqrt{t}$-] $+ \frac12$
$-\frac{1}{2\alpha}\sum a_m t^{m-\frac12}\, m\, \frac{\Pi(m-1)\,\Pi-\frac12}{\Pi(m-\frac12)} - v\,\Pi\tfrac12 \sum a_m t^m + a = 0$
$\frac{1}{\alpha}\, a_{m+\frac12}\, \frac{\Pi\, m+\frac12}{\;} + v\, a_m = 0$
[-$a\frac{\Pi(\alpha v)}{2}$[?]-]
$a_{\frac{\mu+1}{2}}\, \frac{\Pi\frac{\mu+1}{2}}{(\alpha v)^{\mu+1}} = c$
$\varphi t = \sum_{1,\infty} \frac{c\, t^{\frac{\mu}{2}}}{\Pi\frac{\mu}{2}\, (-\alpha v)^{\mu}}$
$\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial t} = \sum_{1,\infty} \frac{c\, t^{\frac{\mu}{2}-1}}{\Pi(\frac{\mu}{2}-1)(-\alpha v)^{\mu}} = \frac{c\, t^{-\frac12}}{\Pi(-\frac12)(-\alpha v)} + \frac{c}{\Pi 0\,(-\alpha v)^2} +$ [-$\frac{\varphi t}{(\alpha v)^2}$ ... $\frac{c\, t^{\frac{\mu}{2}}}{\Pi\frac{\mu}{2}(-\alpha v)}$-]
$\frac{\partial\left(e^{-\alpha^2 v^2 t}\varphi t\right)}{\partial t} = \int_0^t \frac{c\, e^{-\alpha^2v^2 t}\,\partial t}{\Pi 0\, (-\alpha v)^2} + \int_0^t \frac{e^{-\alpha^2v^2t}\, c\, t^{-\frac12}}{\Pi(-\frac12)(-\alpha v)}$

methods.what: Duhamel superposition giving the solution as a time integral over error-function (Gaussian) integrals
Interchange of the order of integration, giving the simplified representation of u
Differentiation in x followed by changes of variable, giving an Abel-type integral for $\partial u/\partial x$
Radiation (Robin) boundary condition at x=0, giving an integral equation for $\varphi$
Power-series ansatz for $\varphi$, termwise integration with Beta/Gamma ($\Pi$) identities, and a recursion for the coefficients
methods.quote: $-\frac{1}{2\alpha}\sum a_m t^{m-\frac12}\, m\, \frac{\Pi(m-1)\,\Pi-\frac12}{\Pi(m-\frac12)} - v\,\Pi\tfrac12 \sum a_m t^m + a = 0$

methods.what: Series solution for $\varphi$ in powers of $t^{1/2}$
Derivative of the series and an expression for the derivative of $e^{-\alpha^2v^2t}\varphi t$ (closed-form summation)
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial\left(e^{-\alpha^2 v^2 t}\varphi t\right)}{\partial t} = \int_0^t \frac{c\, e^{-\alpha^2v^2 t}\,\partial t}{\Pi 0\, (-\alpha v)^2} + \int_0^t \frac{e^{-\alpha^2v^2t}\, c\, t^{-\frac12}}{\Pi(-\frac12)(-\alpha v)}$
